Shearing_Carnassial_Maw.description: An elongated jaw featuring specialized, scissor-like premolar Carnassial teeth in the back of the mouth. They are perfectly adapted to sheer through tough hide and meat after the front canines have secured a firm grip on the fleeing prey.

Bone_Crushing_Molars.description: A steeply domed jawline armed with immensely robust, conical premolars. Rather than merely shearing flesh, these teeth are explicitly evolved to splinter and pulverize the thickest femurs of megafauna to extract the nutrient-rich marrow within.
